name: Troubles And Trials
overview: Scripture teaches that believers will face troubles and trials in this world, yet they are called to trust fully in the Lord rather than their own understanding (Proverbs 3:5). Jesus assures us that though tribulation is inevitable, we can have peace and courage because He has overcome the world (John 16:33). Trials are not to be feared but counted as joy, for enduring them leads to spiritual blessing and the crown of life promised to those who love God (James 1:2, 12). Through Christ’s strength, believers can persevere and see all things working together for good according to God's purpose (Philippians 4:13; Romans 8:28).
